integrity: A self-contained Fourier proof is accompanied by an independent finite dynamic-programming check, which is not an infinite proof. No external validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The proved formula is for the projection of size-r sums to each prime divisor p of N, not the complete distribution modulo composite N. Unlocated general character-enumerator results may already imply the signed-bias formula. Independent proof and priority review remain unperformed.
title: A strict cardinality-by-cardinality subset-sum bias in reduced residue systems
